# Bungalow 69 Clifton

> Official website for Bungalow 69, a private beach villa in Clifton, Cape Town.

- Location: Clifton, Cape Town, South Africa
- Property: Entire private villa
- Capacity: Up to 6 guests
- Accommodation: 4 bedrooms, 5 beds and 3.5 bathrooms
- Highlights: Private pool, Atlantic Ocean views and direct access to Clifton Fourth Beach
- Official booking page: https://www.airbnb.co.uk/rooms/45670818
